backup.title: Full backup
backup.importedWithCounts: Backup restored: {rows} rows and {files} files. Reload before using the restored data.
backup.description: Export the current business configuration, Agent state, audit/notification records and referenced background, Artifact and plugin files. Account credentials, Passkeys and active resources are excluded.
backup.importDescription: Backups from this instance can be imported while signed in without a backup password. Backups from another instance require the login password used when that backup was exported. Import replaces the backed-up business data and custom theme files.
backup.backupPasswordHelp: Leave blank for a backup created by this instance. For a cross-instance restore, enter the password used when the backup was exported.
backup.confirmImport: Restore this backup and replace all backed-up business data? Verify the target instance first. Existing active resources will close.
backup.restoring: Restoring. Keep this application open until the result is confirmed.
backup.cleanupPending: Restoration is confirmed; old-file cleanup remains pending. Reload to continue with the restored state.
backup.unknown: The restoration result is unknown. Do not submit the import again.
backup.unknownRecovery: Keep the server data intact. Reconcile through server restart and read-only inspection before further changes.
backup.invalidInput: Check the password and select a non-empty current backup no larger than 100 MiB.
backup.busy: Another backup is in progress or the source changed. Read the current state before trying again.
backup.operationFailed: The backup request failed. Verify authentication and server availability.
